note: Layer 16 was selected in week 1 by argmax of refusal_rate(), the substring matcher later measured at 5.6% precision. week4 s2 shows that matcher is pinned at 100% for layers 10-18 while clean refusal moves 85 points underneath it, so the selection could not distinguish layer 12 from layer 16 and the argmax was arbitrary within the saturated span. Layer 16 is now known to be the WORST layer in the range (37.5% broken vs 0% at 10-14). Set it from the s6 verdict, and record the parameterisation you set it in -- raw multiplier is not an intervention strength.
norm_ref_note: norm_ref is ||v|| at layer 16, the weeks 1-3.5 anchor. adass.norm_ref_vector() rescales any layer's vector to it so the multiplier axis is comparable across depth; adass.rel_mult_for() does the same against mean ||h||, which is the axis H1/H2/H3 should use.
